attributes.board_name: New Jersey State Board of Marriage and Family Therapy Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses/programs from the providers listed in N.J.A.C. 13:34-5.3(a)1 (see also 13:34-15.4).
rules.carryover: Up to 10 CEUs may be carried into the next biennial period (N.J.A.C. 13:34-5.2(e)).

topics.who: Ethical and legal standards related to marriage and family therapy
Prescription opioid drugs incl. risks and signs of abuse, addiction and diversion (N.J.S.A. 45:8B-24.1c)

rules.notes: Licenses expire June 30 of even-numbered years. Max 20 CEUs online (asynchronous); the other 20 face-to-face or live interactive webinars.
rules.rule_quote: How many Continuing Education Units (CEU’s) does an LMFT need for each biennial renewal period? Pursuant to N.J.A.C. 13:34-5.2(b) and (c), 40 CEU’s are required every two (2) years.

rules.notes: Associate MFTs confirm completion of 20 contact hours on the renewal application. Licenses expire June 30 of even-numbered years.
